title: Cursor Enterprise procurement review matrix
status: Evidence-backed control questions; buyer-specific behavior remains contract/console test-required.

rows.cursorBehavior: Require SAML or OIDC SSO and disable local login where the plan permits it.
rows.enterpriseSetting: Verify supported IdP, enforcement scope, break-glass behavior, and domain claim in the admin console.
rows.risk: Account takeover, orphaned access, or local-login bypass.
rows.verificationMethod: Sign in with an assigned user and attempt a local-login bypass.
rows.passCriteria: Assigned users authenticate through the approved IdP and local bypass is blocked.

rows.cursorBehavior: Provision and deprovision users and groups from the authoritative directory.
rows.enterpriseSetting: Verify group mapping, seat removal, token revocation, and plan availability in the contract and console.
rows.risk: Account takeover, orphaned access, or local-login bypass.
rows.verificationMethod: Create, update, suspend, and delete a test user through SCIM.
rows.passCriteria: Every lifecycle event reaches Cursor within the documented service window.

rows.cursorBehavior: Keep emergency admin access limited, monitored, and tested.
rows.enterpriseSetting: Cursor's public pages do not define a universal break-glass workflow; verify available controls.
rows.risk: Account takeover, orphaned access, or local-login bypass.
rows.verificationMethod: Review named emergency accounts and run a documented access test.
rows.passCriteria: Emergency access has MFA, a named owner, an expiry or review date, and an audit trail.

rows.cursorBehavior: Assign organization roles according to least privilege.
rows.enterpriseSetting: Verify the exact role catalog and permissions in the active workspace.
rows.risk: Privilege creep or an unreviewed user gaining administrative scope.
rows.verificationMethod: Export or review every privileged member and business justification.
rows.passCriteria: Each privileged account has a current owner and required responsibility.

rows.cursorBehavior: Use identity groups and policies to isolate experimental users from production-facing teams.
rows.enterpriseSetting: Verify whether every required policy can be scoped by group.
rows.risk: Privilege creep or an unreviewed user gaining administrative scope.
rows.verificationMethod: Compare membership, repository scope, models, MCPs, and agent rules across groups.
rows.passCriteria: Pilot permissions cannot silently expand production access.

rows.cursorBehavior: Enable and enforce Privacy Mode for all covered users.
rows.enterpriseSetting: Verify plan, workspace, account, and client-specific behavior in the console and agreement.
rows.risk: Unapproved retention, training, provider, subprocessor, or residency exposure.
rows.verificationMethod: Inspect the organization setting and test inheritance with a new member.
rows.passCriteria: New and existing members inherit the enforced setting.

rows.cursorBehavior: Confirm that Privacy Mode excludes customer data from Cursor and model-provider training.
rows.enterpriseSetting: Required: public marketing alone is not sufficient for the buyer's legal requirement.
rows.risk: Unapproved retention, training, provider, subprocessor, or residency exposure.
rows.verificationMethod: Map the public claim to the signed DPA or MSA and active workspace setting.
rows.passCriteria: Contract language and console configuration support the same exclusion.

rows.cursorBehavior: Confirm the zero-data-retention arrangement for every enabled provider and model.
rows.enterpriseSetting: Required: validate provider, model, region, abuse-monitoring exception, and change notification in contract or trust evidence.
rows.risk: Unapproved retention, training, provider, subprocessor, or residency exposure.
rows.verificationMethod: Request the provider matrix and compare it with the model allowlist.
rows.passCriteria: Each enabled model has a documented retention treatment and exception path.

rows.cursorBehavior: Document retention for prompts, code context, indexes, logs, analytics, support records, and backups.
rows.enterpriseSetting: Unknown until the active agreement, plan, features, and support process are reviewed.
rows.risk: Unapproved retention, training, provider, subprocessor, or residency exposure.
rows.verificationMethod: Build a data-flow and retention table from contract, product settings, and trust evidence.
rows.passCriteria: Every data class has a duration, deletion path, and accountable owner.

rows.cursorBehavior: Review Cursor and model-provider subprocessors before rollout and after changes.
rows.enterpriseSetting: Verify contract notice period and objection or termination rights.
rows.risk: Unapproved retention, training, provider, subprocessor, or residency exposure.
rows.verificationMethod: Download the current list, record purpose and location, and test change-notice handling.
rows.passCriteria: All material processors are approved or have a documented exception.

rows.cursorBehavior: Map required regions to actual processing, storage, backup, and support locations.
rows.enterpriseSetting: Public pages do not establish a universal customer-selectable residency option; verify contractually.
rows.risk: Unapproved retention, training, provider, subprocessor, or residency exposure.
rows.verificationMethod: Compare architecture and subprocessor evidence with policy requirements.
rows.passCriteria: No unapproved region receives protected data.

rows.cursorBehavior: Confirm TLS in transit and AES-256 at rest claims for covered services.
rows.enterpriseSetting: Verify feature scope, exclusions, key ownership, and availability of CMEK in the purchased plan.
rows.risk: Protected code or prompts exposed without the required encryption boundary.
rows.verificationMethod: Review trust evidence and, where available, configuration for customer-managed keys.
rows.passCriteria: Required data paths meet the organization's encryption standard.

rows.cursorBehavior: Limit which repositories agents and users may access.
rows.enterpriseSetting: Verify whether policy is allowlist, blocklist, or both and which agent surfaces it covers.
rows.risk: Sensitive repositories or files become available to an agent unexpectedly.
rows.verificationMethod: Attempt access to one approved and one denied repository.
rows.passCriteria: Approved access works; denied access fails and is logged.

rows.cursorBehavior: Use repository exclusions and product policy to keep secrets and restricted paths out of AI requests.
rows.enterpriseSetting: Cursor describes best-effort exclusions; verify residual risk and do not treat ignore files as a secret boundary.
rows.risk: Sensitive repositories or files become available to an agent unexpectedly.
rows.verificationMethod: Run a controlled test against denied paths and inspect client behavior.
rows.passCriteria: Restricted files are not intentionally included in prompts, indexes, or agent actions.

rows.cursorBehavior: Allow only approved models and providers.
rows.enterpriseSetting: Verify new-model defaults, router behavior, provider retention, and change control.
rows.risk: An unapproved model or provider receives company code or prompts.
rows.verificationMethod: Compare the console allowlist with procurement and privacy approvals.
rows.passCriteria: Only reviewed models are selectable or routable.

rows.cursorBehavior: Allow only reviewed MCP servers and remove stale connections.
rows.enterpriseSetting: Verify policy coverage for desktop, CLI, cloud agents, plugins, and user-defined servers.
rows.risk: An unreviewed MCP server or credential can perform an external action.
rows.verificationMethod: Attempt to connect an approved and an unapproved MCP server.
rows.passCriteria: Unapproved servers are blocked; approved servers have an owner and review date.

rows.cursorBehavior: Issue scoped credentials per server and avoid long-lived shared secrets.
rows.enterpriseSetting: Verify where tokens are stored and which administrators or agents can reveal them.
rows.risk: An unreviewed MCP server or credential can perform an external action.
rows.verificationMethod: Inspect the credential store, scopes, rotation record, and revocation test.
rows.passCriteria: Credentials are least-privileged, non-exported where possible, rotated, and revocable.

rows.cursorBehavior: Configure organization-wide agent policies before broad rollout.
rows.enterpriseSetting: Verify precedence, supported clients, sync timing, and exception workflow.
rows.risk: Autonomous commands, network access, or prompt injection cross the approval boundary.
rows.verificationMethod: Inspect required rules and test behavior with a new user.
rows.passCriteria: Mandatory rules apply to supported agent surfaces and cannot be silently bypassed.

rows.control: Constrain auto-run, browser, and network access
rows.cursorBehavior: Set conservative defaults for autonomous terminal, browser, and network actions.
rows.enterpriseSetting: Verify differences among local, CLI, background, and cloud agents.
rows.risk: Autonomous commands, network access, or prompt injection cross the approval boundary.
rows.verificationMethod: Run controlled allowed and denied actions in each supported agent surface.
rows.passCriteria: Denied actions require approval or fail; allowed actions are traceable.

rows.cursorBehavior: Use restricted execution for agent terminal commands where supported.
rows.enterpriseSetting: Verify team-wide enforcement, bypass permissions, platform differences, and known exclusions.
rows.risk: Autonomous commands, network access, or prompt injection cross the approval boundary.
rows.verificationMethod: Test workspace boundaries, temporary-file access, network denial, and escape handling.
rows.passCriteria: The configured sandbox restricts the expected files and network paths.

rows.cursorBehavior: Use managed hooks to observe or block sensitive agent actions.
rows.enterpriseSetting: Verify server-side distribution, tamper resistance, timeout behavior, and plan availability.
rows.risk: Autonomous commands, network access, or prompt injection cross the approval boundary.
rows.verificationMethod: Trigger before-prompt and before-command hooks with allowed and denied examples.
rows.passCriteria: Required hooks run, fail closed where intended, and generate reviewable evidence.

rows.cursorBehavior: Exercise untrusted repository, web, issue, and MCP content against the approved configuration.
rows.enterpriseSetting: No public vendor page proves safety for the buyer's exact tools and data; validate locally.
rows.risk: Autonomous commands, network access, or prompt injection cross the approval boundary.
rows.verificationMethod: Run a documented adversarial test with canary secrets and denied tools.
rows.passCriteria: The agent does not exfiltrate canaries or cross the configured approval boundary.

rows.cursorBehavior: Capture access, administrative, rule, and configuration events.
rows.enterpriseSetting: Verify event catalog, retention, API or export, latency, and plan limits.
rows.risk: The organization cannot attribute, investigate, or prove a high-risk action.
rows.verificationMethod: Change a test setting and confirm the event appears in dashboard and CSV export.
rows.passCriteria: Event identity, timestamp, action, target, and outcome are available for the required period.

rows.cursorBehavior: Review adoption, usage, and AI-code metrics without over-collecting employee data.
rows.enterpriseSetting: Verify exact fields and legal basis before enabling broad reporting.
rows.risk: The organization cannot attribute, investigate, or prove a high-risk action.
rows.verificationMethod: Inventory dashboard fields, API outputs, recipients, and retention.
rows.passCriteria: Metrics have a declared purpose, access control, retention period, and employee notice where required.

rows.cursorBehavior: Route available audit evidence into the organization's monitoring and incident workflow.
rows.enterpriseSetting: Verify supported export or API paths and compensate for unavailable events.
rows.risk: The organization cannot attribute, investigate, or prove a high-risk action.
rows.verificationMethod: Generate a high-risk test event and trace it from Cursor to the response queue.
rows.passCriteria: The event is ingested, enriched, assigned, and retained under policy.

rows.cursorBehavior: Request current SOC 2 Type II and penetration-test materials from the trust portal.
rows.enterpriseSetting: Required: verify report coverage and bridge letters; certification is not a universal guarantee.
rows.risk: Contractual or control gaps remain invisible until an incident or assessment.
rows.verificationMethod: Record report period, exceptions, complementary controls, and remediation commitments.
rows.passCriteria: Evidence is current and gaps are accepted by accountable owners.

rows.cursorBehavior: Set contractual notification, cooperation, evidence-preservation, and post-incident obligations.
rows.enterpriseSetting: Public pages do not define every customer's binding incident terms; verify the MSA or DPA.
rows.risk: Contractual or control gaps remain invisible until an incident or assessment.
rows.verificationMethod: Map the signed agreement to the incident response plan and contacts.
rows.passCriteria: Timeframes and responsibilities meet organizational requirements.

rows.cursorBehavior: Validate account, workspace, index, token, automation, and retained-data cleanup.
rows.enterpriseSetting: Verify backups, legal holds, logs, shared artifacts, and contract termination handling.
rows.risk: Stale access, data, or configuration survives offboarding or a material change.
rows.verificationMethod: Offboard a test user and submit a deletion request; record each completion.
rows.passCriteria: Access is revoked promptly and deletion follows the documented schedule.

rows.control: Monitor material product and policy changes
rows.cursorBehavior: Track changes to models, subprocessors, retention, security features, and acquisition status.
rows.enterpriseSetting: Verify notification channels and contractual change rights.
rows.risk: Stale access, data, or configuration survives offboarding or a material change.
rows.verificationMethod: Review vendor notices monthly and compare them with the approved baseline.
rows.passCriteria: Material changes create a documented reassessment before policy expansion.

rows.control: Maintain an exit and portability plan
rows.cursorBehavior: Keep repository instructions, workflows, evidence, and critical automations portable to another agent.
rows.enterpriseSetting: Verify export availability, data return, deletion, license termination, and dependency inventory.
rows.risk: Stale access, data, or configuration survives offboarding or a material change.
rows.verificationMethod: Run an annual migration exercise on a representative repository.
rows.passCriteria: The team can revoke Cursor access and continue critical work within the recovery objective.
